common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Mushy brown leaves collapsing at base
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Withhold water; ensure drainage hole is never blocked

prevention_guidance: The number one rule: when in doubt, do not water. Snake plants thrive on neglect

common_name: Areca Palm / Butterfly Palm / Golden Cane Palm
indian_states: Pan-India (popular ornamental clumping landscape and indoor container palm)

leaf_characteristics.shape: Pinnate arching graceful feathery fronds (1.5–2 m) with 40–60 pairs of narrow lanceolate leaflets and golden-yellow petioles
leaf_characteristics.color: Vibrant bright green with yellow-green midribs

stem_characteristics: Multi-stemmed clump-forming clustered bamboo-like ringed canes, golden-yellow to green, 2–6 m
flower_characteristics: Branched panicles of small yellow flowers emerging below leaf crown
fruit_characteristics: Small oblong yellowish fruit turning black when ripe
growth_habit: Multi-stemmed clumping evergreen feather palm, 2–6 meters
habitat_and_climate: Warm, humid tropical climate; sensitive to dry scorching hot winds and frost
sunlight_requirements: Bright indirect filtered sunlight (direct harsh midday summer sun scorches foliage)
water_requirements: Moderate regular moisture; keep root ball evenly moist with good drainage
soil_preferences: Rich, loose, well-drained potting mix with compost and cocopeat, pH 6.0–7.0
uses: India's most popular indoor luxury container palm and garden border screening palm
Top-rated indoor humidifier and air purifier (removes airborne xylene and toluene)
Non-toxic to pets
safety_notes: Completely non-toxic to dogs, cats, and humans. Safe indoor plant.

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Spider Mites (Tetranychidae)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Fine webbing beneath fronds, stippled yellowing foliage in dry indoor air
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Mist fronds regularly; spray neem oil or water jet

prevention_guidance: Use filtered or rested tap water to avoid brown crispy leaf tips from fluoride/chlorine salts
